correctness.rationale: For every nonclosed open support \(U\), the proof constructs a rapidly convergent sequence toward a boundary point and pairwise disjoint positive bumps. Their synthesis map is an isometric lattice embedding of \(c_0\), evaluation is a contractive lattice retraction, and continuity at the boundary point forces the evaluation sequence into \(c_0\). Retract permanence and the published non-semiprojectivity of \(c_0\) give the negative direction. For clopen \(U\), extension by zero identifies \(I_F\) with \(C(U)\), and the published \(C(U)\)-ANR theorem gives the exact positive criterion. The standard closed-ideal correspondence is justified by an explicit clipping approximation.
